environment.description: Same application deployed behind AWS CloudFront distribution with Lambda@Edge viewer-request function that performs request canonicalization. The distribution has an associated AWS WAF WebACL with: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_BODY enabled, (2) a custom rate-based rule scoped to the URI path /api/auth/* with a threshold of 100 requests per 5-minute window per source IP, aggregated on forwarded-for header with fallback to source IP. The rate-based rule action is BLOCK returning 429. Additionally, the Lambda@Edge function applies NFKC normalization to all URI path segments and query parameters BEFORE forwarding to origin, and rejects (403) any request where the pre-normalization and post-normalization byte lengths differ by more than 20%, which prevents Unicode homoglyph/normalization attacks from reaching the application. CloudFront also enforces a 32KB request body size limit.

lambda_edge.normalization: NFKC on URI path segments and query params

config.rate_limiting: WAF rate-based rule returns 429 before request reaches origin
